3 فَاحَصَنِى , (K,) inf. n. مُفَاحَصَةٌ, (TK,) [and app. فِحَاصٌ also,] (assumed tropical:) [He did] as though he searched after, or into, my vice, or fault, and my secret, I doing the same with respect to his. (K, TA.) ―
-b2- [Hence, app., the saying,] بَيْنَهُمَا فِحَاصٌ (assumed tropical:) Between them two is enmity. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
